title: Unconditional Promotion of Test Invoice Series in Migration c7_12
description: Migration c7_12 (lines 38-51) unconditionally promoted test prefixes (SAFE-TEST, CONC, FYBND, LKTEST, PRT-8899) to APPROVED and assigned synthetic approver identities 'ca_audit_signed' and 'partner_audit_signed'.
remediation: Forward-only corrective migration c7_13 reclassified all synthetic records to REVOKED_SYNTHETIC with is_active = false and logged an immutable audit trail event.
verification: test_phase4_3_compliance.cjs and test_workstream_i_migration_recovery.cjs verified 0 synthetic APPROVED records remain.

title: Lack of Database-Level State Machine & Synthetic Approver Prevention
description: Ordinary database connections could directly execute UPDATE public.invoice_sequence SET approval_status = 'APPROVED', authorized_by = 'ca_audit_signed', bypassing application route guards.
remediation: Installed trigger trg_invoice_sequence_governance blocking synthetic approver strings, enforcing terminal status locks on DEPRECATED_HISTORICAL and REVOKED_SYNTHETIC, and adding DDL CHECK constraints on prefix format and approval_status values.
verification: Direct SQL injection tests in Workstream I and Scenario J-14 confirmed trigger raises exception STATUTORY_SECURITY_VIOLATION and performs atomic transaction rollback.

title: Overly Permissive Statutory Approval API Route
description: Route /admin/compliance/invoice-series/approve permitted ordinary ADMIN role to approve statutory series without verified statutory delegation, and did not check current series state before approving.
remediation: Hardened route.ts to strictly require role FINANCE_CONTROLLER or delegated SUPER_ADMIN (ordinary ADMIN rejected with HTTP 403), verify that series is in PROPOSED/SUSPENDED status, and bind approver identity strictly to authenticated session context.
verification: Scenarios J-01 through J-05 and J-18, J-19 confirmed 403 for ordinary admin and successful approval only for authorized roles.

title: Absence of Immutable Audit Log Table for Series State Transitions
description: Status changes on invoice_sequence only overwrote table columns without maintaining an append-only historical record of who approved, revoked, or modified series.
remediation: Created public.invoice_series_approval_audit table with BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger raising STATUTORY_SECURITY_VIOLATION, ensuring 100% append-only immutability.
verification: Workstream I and Scenario J-20 confirmed that updates and deletes are blocked, and all state transitions automatically insert audit events.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Lacked Automated Migration Synthetic String Linting
description: Deployment pipeline had no pre-deployment gate scanning SQL migrations for synthetic approver identities or unreviewed series promotions.
remediation: Created frontend/scripts/lint_migrations.cjs which parses all migration files, detects prohibited approvers ('ca_audit_signed', 'partner_audit_signed', 'system_audit'), and enforces non-zero exit code to block deployment.
verification: Ran linter in CI mode; verified that raw historical defects in c7_12 are detected and blocked, while remediated baseline passes.

title: Production Invoice Series Formal Approval Pending Corporate Designation
description: CakeToHome India Private Limited board of directors / CFO has not yet formally designated and signed the statutory production invoice prefix and CA delegation resolution.
remediation: Preserved fail-closed guard in allocate_invoice_number. No production prefix selected or approved in Phase 4.3.
verification: Verified allocate_invoice_number fails closed on any unapproved prefix under CGST Rule 46.
